verses.he: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־אֲ֭נִי בְּתֻמִּ֣י הָלַ֑כְתִּי וּבַיהוָ֥ה בָּ֝טַ֗חְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶמְעָֽד׃
verses.en: [A Psalm] of David. Judge me, O LORD, for I have walked in mine integrity, And I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.

verses.he: בְּחָנֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה וְנַסֵּ֑נִי צרופה [צָרְפָ֖ה] כִלְיוֹתַ֣י וְלִבִּֽי׃
verses.en: Examine me, O LORD, and try me; Test my reins and my heart.
For Thy mercy is before mine eyes; And I have walked in Thy truth.

verses.he: לֹא־יָ֭שַׁבְתִּי עִם־מְתֵי־שָׁ֑וְא וְעִ֥ם נַ֝עֲלָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א אָבֽוֹא׃
verses.en: I have not sat with men of falsehood; Neither will I go in with dissemblers.

verses.he: שָׂ֭נֵאתִי קְהַ֣ל מְרֵעִ֑ים וְעִם־רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א אֵשֵֽׁב׃
verses.en: I hate the gathering of evil doers, And will not sit with the wicked.

verses.he: אֶרְחַ֣ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּ֑י וַאֲסֹבְבָ֖ה אֶת־מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: I will wash my hands in innocency; So will I compass Thine altar, O LORD,
That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, And tell of all Thy wondrous works.

verses.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה אָ֭הַבְתִּי מְע֣וֹן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מְק֗וֹם מִשְׁכַּ֥ן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: LORD, I love the habitation of Thy house, And the place where Thy glory dwelleth.

verses.he: אַל־תֶּאֱסֹ֣ף עִם־חַטָּאִ֣ים נַפְשִׁ֑י וְעִם־אַנְשֵׁ֖י דָמִ֣ים חַיָּֽי׃
verses.en: Gather not my soul with sinners, Nor my life with men of blood;
In whose hands is craftiness, And their right hand is full of bribes.
But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity; Redeem me, and be gracious unto me.

verses.he: רַ֭גְלִי עָֽמְדָ֣ה בְמִישׁ֑וֹר בְּ֝מַקְהֵלִ֗ים אֲבָרֵ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: My foot standeth in an even place; In the congregations will I bless the LORD.
